title: A Journey into the Interior of the Earth
sourceTitle: A Journey into the Interior of the Earth
author: Jules Verne
description: "A Journey into the Interior of the Earth" by Jules Verne is a science fiction novel first published in 1864.
longDescription: Professor Otto Lidenbrock, an eccentric German scientist, discovers a cryptic message suggesting a path to Earth's center through an Icelandic volcano. With his nephew Axel and guide Hans, he descends into Snæfellsjökull's depths.

authorInfo.bio: Jules Verne (1828–1905) is the credited author of this historical edition. Works available in this collection include Around the World in Eighty Days, A Journey to the Centre of the Earth, The Mysterious Island, From the Earth to the moon; and, round the moon. The linked author record provides further bibliographic details.
